LVGLab 0.11.0 adds a preview drawn by LVGL itself, tabs for several projects, search and a lot of copy and paste.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.11.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.11.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.11.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.11.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.11.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- **LVGL preview** (Preferences > Canvas > Preview): LVGL 8.3 is compiled into LVGLab and draws the screen from the code
  of the export, so the canvas shows exactly what the device draws: fonts (also your own), texts of all languages,
  theme colors, images and components. It needs a C compiler only when you build from source. The default stays the
  fast editor renderer. Projects for LVGL 9 and the simulator still use the editor's drawing.
- **Tabs**: several projects open at once, each with its own history, selection and view (Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+W).
- **Search** (Ctrl+F): widgets, property values, styles, events and flags across all screens and components.
- **Copy and paste**: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V now work with the keyboard (they did not before), also between tabs and
  windows. A copied screen takes its components, fonts, images and theme colors along. **Copy properties / Paste
  properties** (Ctrl+Shift+C / V) transfer the look of a widget to other widgets of the same type.
- **Layers**: Shift+click selects a range, Ctrl+click toggles, and a selection can be dragged into a container.
- **Timeline per screen**: *This screen only* lists the steps that changed this screen; a click restores only that screen.
- **Screenshots and randomizer**: export a PNG of every screen at display resolution; one click fills widgets with
  plausible random values.
- **Simulator**: tab buttons switch the page of a tab view, dragging scrolls a roller.
- Widget pickers (event targets, references) have a search field; new app icon; larger close buttons on the start page.
- Command line: several project files open in tabs, `--renderer`, `--language`, `--appearance`.

## Fixed

- Component instances set their own alignment, so they sit where the editor shows them.
- Undo in a text field no longer brings back the text of another widget.
- The AI assistant asks for pixel radii; very large radii mean "circle".
- Tab view: *Active tab* property, exported with `lv_tabview_set_act` (LVGL 8) / `lv_tabview_set_active` (LVGL 9).
